pretreatments.description: Mechanical cutting of PBAT/PLA and PBAT/PLA/starch plastic bags into 2 cm × 2 cm square pieces
Alkaline treatment using NaOH at a concentration of 1% (w/v) with a plastic to alkaline solution ratio of 50 g TS/L
Thermal treatment by heating samples in a water bath at 70 °C for 48 h
